# Terraform provider for Algizian

> Manage Algizian (OAuth 2.1 / OpenID Connect server with social logins, https://algizian.com) from Terraform: tenants, custom domains, OIDC clients, own provider apps, email sign-in, service accounts, with tags. Registry source: elmerisllc/algizian.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): install (also without the Registry, with signature check), authentication, what each token type can do, things to know
- [Provider configuration](docs/index.md)

## Resources
- [algizian_tenant](docs/resources/tenant.md): a tenant (branding, providers, tags, deletion lock)
- [algizian_custom_domain](docs/resources/custom_domain.md): the tenant's issuer domain and its DNS record
- [algizian_client](docs/resources/client.md): OIDC client
- [algizian_provider_credentials](docs/resources/provider_credentials.md): own Google, Microsoft or Apple app
- [algizian_email_settings](docs/resources/email_settings.md): email-code sign-in
- [algizian_service_account](docs/resources/service_account.md) and [algizian_service_account_token](docs/resources/service_account_token.md)

## Data sources
- [algizian_tenant](docs/data-sources/tenant.md), [algizian_tenants](docs/data-sources/tenants.md), [algizian_providers](docs/data-sources/providers.md)

## Examples
- [examples/](examples/): complete configurations for every resource
